target_customer: Financial institutions, fintechs and crypto service providers facing authorized push payment (APP) fraud
problem: Scammers run short lived scam sites that trick users into paying, and banks cannot spot them in time. Alterya uses AI agents to detect scams targeting users.
business_model: B2B API and SaaS sold to financial institutions

founders.name: Elad Fouks
founders.background_notes: Cybersecurity group leader in unit 8200 and former special operations officer per YC.

founders.name: Shahaf Gonen
founders.background_notes: Per YC. Other sources name Guy Eshel as co-founder and CTO, a conflict.

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting scam sites that rotate domains quickly requires crawling, classification and agent systems running at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated scam detection data and team expertise helped, but fraud vendors like Feedzai and BioCatch were adding scam products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added scam products later. Chainalysis bought Alterya in January 2025, reported near 150 million dollars.

market_need_then: APP fraud was a growing issue for banks, with UK regulation moving toward reimbursement. No Alterya specific demand data found for 2022.

branding.domain_note: Used alterya.dev for its site, not an exact .com.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name but no press on the brand, community or merch. Brand visibility came through the acquisition coverage only.

outcome_analysis: Alterya was a Tel Aviv team with elite intelligence unit backgrounds that built AI agents to find scam sites for banks and crypto firms. Chainalysis bought it in January 2025 for a reported 150 to 160 million dollars, about two and a half years after the YC batch, keeping its 28 employees as a local R&D center. The outcome was strong for a company of its size.
notes: Funding unverified: Seedtable and startup aggregators list a 9.8M seed in September 2022 led by Battery Ventures (with NFX, Nyca, YC), while CB Insights lists only a 0.5M convertible note from YC on 2022-09-07. Neither is confirmed by a primary source, so no round is recorded. Price conflict: CoinDesk and Business Insider say 150M, Globes says 160M. Co-founder conflict: YC says Shahaf Gonen, others say Guy Eshel. Company website www.alterya.dev could not be resolved in this session. Search found no competitor sources from 2022, only later launches.
